ontology.compatibility: Backward-compatible superset of the supplied ontology-viewer JSON model. Core arrays classes/edges/attributes are retained; explicit rule catalogs, edge rules, relationship attributes, evidence, FIBO alignment and conversion audit are added to prevent information loss.

modelingPolicy.classRules: Class.rules contains intrinsic business rules evidenced by the class row and/or its owned properties.
modelingPolicy.edgeRules: Edge.rules contains business-rule references plus the exact edge applicability condition as a local edgeCondition rule.
modelingPolicy.propertyRules: Property.constraintOrRule and Property.ruleRefs preserve property-level constraints.
modelingPolicy.notNodeConcepts: Source concepts marked NOT_NODE are preserved under excludedConcepts with full traceability rather than discarded.
modelingPolicy.reviewConcepts: Source concepts marked NEED_REVIEW remain renderable classes with modeling.status=NEED_REVIEW.
